observations: On the left, a figure with a wide flared skirt and layered ruffled shoulders stands upright, its open-mouthed face built from overlapping loops of blue, red, and pink line over warm gold fill.
On the right, a compact bird-like figure with a flat beak and frowning brow is densely hatched in orange-brown and deep purple, its right arm extended stiffly upward ending in a small fist.
Behind both figures, loose yellow arcs and pink diagonal lines sweep across a muted mauve-grey ground, with no single focal point anchoring the background marks.
reading: Two figures face each other across an open middle ground, one expansive and open-mouthed, the other compact and scowling. The contrast in posture—spread skirt against tight feathered body—reads as confrontation or standoff. The background lines do not resolve into a setting; they press forward as noise or weather. The mood feels charged but unresolved, the outcome genuinely unclear.
